info.title: PDF Task Status API Reference
info.description: Check the status of a previously initiated PDF processing task using its unique task ID. Returns task status, creation and expiry timestamps, output file URLs and IDs, and input file IDs. Supports status values: queued, processing, completed, failed.

tags: Task Status and File Info APIs
get.description: This API checks the status of a previously initiated PDF processing task using its unique task ID.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Specifies the desired format for the API response. Choose 'json' for a JSON object or 'xml' for an XML structure.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the PDF processing task for which the status is requested.

failed.summary: Task failed (e.g. invalid page range/format caught during processing)

value.message: One or more specified page numbers exceed the total number of pages in the PDF document.

400.description: Bad Request — Missing required task_id parameter

value.message: Please provide a valid task ID.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

taskId.description: The unique identifier of the PDF processing task.

status.description: The current status of the task (e.g., 'queued', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed').

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the task status was created, formatted as 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'.

zipFileId.description: The unique identifier for the ZIP file. This is present only when the task status is 'COMPLETED'.

outputUrls.description: A list of URLs for each individual output file. This is present only when the task is 'COMPLETED'.

outputIds.description: A list of unique IDs for the output files. This is present only when the task is 'COMPLETED'.

inputIds.description: A list of unique IDs for the input files submitted with the task. If the task was initiated with the `destroy` parameter set to `true`, `inputIds` will not be generated.

error.description: The error code for the PDF Task. This is included only if the task fails.

message.description: A descriptive message indicating the reason for task failure. This is included only if the task fails.

expiresAt.description: The timestamp when the task status will expire and be removed from the system, formatted as 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'.

zipFileUrl.description: The URL to download all output files as a single ZIP archive. Present only when the task status is completed.

TaskStatusResponse.description: Task status response containing the current state of a PDF processing task.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.
